parameters.query:
SELECT
  (SELECT jsonb_object_agg(key, value) FROM ava.settings) AS settings,
  (SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id', id, 'start', start_at, 'end', end_at)), '[]'::jsonb)
     FROM ava.bookings WHERE status IN ('pending', 'approved') AND end_at > now()) AS holds

parameters.content:
## Find Open Slots
All scheduling rules live here, in code, never in the AI prompt: work days and hours, 30/60 min calls, 15 min buffers, 4 h minimum notice, 30 day window. Pending and approved bookings count as busy so two clients can never request the same slot.
